purpose.summary: Make the baseline and candidate independently acquire the same bounded mainnet prefix from public peers before offline restart and comparison.
scope: Run the exact baseline and candidate sequentially with fresh distinct datadirs, outbound public mainnet discovery, no inbound public service, no wallet, and stop-at-height 288.
Restart each role offline and compare genesis plus the immutable height-288 block hash, raw header, and chainwork.
Remove the loopback baseline server, candidate-only loopback client, and historical IBD service overrides from the prior smoke.
Retain bounded height, time, disk, process, port, privacy, report, and cleanup failure laws.

Keep the existing public reproduction target pinned to ERGON-CHANGE-0016 while decoupling its historical self-test from the evolving checkout runner, and make CI exercise the current ERGON-CHANGE-0018 harness self-test separately.
exclusions: No production-node, consensus, validation, build recipe, dependency lock, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet, mainnet-parameter, cockpit, roadmap, or evidence change.
No current-tip, full-history, simultaneous-operation, sustained-operation, inbound-service, peer-diversity, operator-binary, mining, mempool, fee, DAA, reorganization, or pruning claim.
No assumption that the two roles reach different public peers; independence is limited to process, binary, datadir, configuration, ports, and acquisition lifecycle.
No raw child output, peer address, absolute host path, parent environment, cookie, secret, port, datadir, or runtime artifact enters the report.

commands: Build exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 in a clean dedicated root under the existing locked Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 profile.
expected_results: The clean baseline source and executable identities are recorded externally and remain unchanged through the scenario.

commands: Build the exact direct-child ERGON-CHANGE-0018 candidate in a distinct clean root under the same profile.
expected_results: The clean candidate source and executable identities are recorded externally and remain unchanged through the scenario.

scenarios.command: Run tests/compatibility/mainnet/run_passive_smoke.py with exact fresh baseline and candidate executables, a new work root, and a new report path.
expected_results: Each role independently acquires public mainnet blocks through checkpoint 288, restarts offline, and produces the same genesis, block hash, raw header, and chainwork before complete cleanup.
failure_conditions: Any binary, datadir, port, process, network-surface, chain, checkpoint, restart, resource-bound, report-privacy, or cleanup violation fails closed; unavailable public acquisition remains inconclusive.

scenarios.command: Rerun the unchanged accepted legacy-mining-baseline regression gate against the exact baseline build.
expected_results: The accepted baseline mining fixture still passes without skip or source mutation.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, identity mismatch, cache escape, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Rerun the unchanged accepted legacy-mining-candidate regression gate against the exact candidate build.
expected_results: The accepted candidate mining fixture still passes without skip or source mutation.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, identity mismatch, cache escape, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Rerun the unchanged accepted inherited default-launch regression gate against the exact candidate build.
expected_results: The inherited selection still passes without skip or source mutation.
failure_conditions: Any selection drift, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, cache escape, or cleanup failure fails closed.

platforms: future locked Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 public reconstruction

limitations: A successful run would establish two separately configured public-prefix acquisitions and offline checkpoint agreement only through height 288.
The two roles may contact the same peer; the harness does not establish peer-set, host, network-path, or operator independence.
The bounded sequential scenario does not reach current tip and does not establish full history, simultaneous or sustained coexistence, inbound service, or operator-binary parity.
The harness binds executable bytes but relies on an external reviewed build record to bind each executable to exact source.
The existing manual workflow dispatch remains bound to ERGON-CHANGE-0016 and its v1 report; a later binding commit must target the public ERGON-CHANGE-0018 SHA before any v2 reproduction run.
counterevidence: No public reconstruction of this direct-public candidate profile exists at record-review time.
The successful ERGON-CHANGE-0017 workflow transferred candidate blocks only from a loopback baseline and therefore did not test candidate public peer discovery or direct public synchronization.
Bounded agreement at checkpoint 288 cannot resolve current-tip, full-history, long-duration, operator-binary, or simultaneous-operation questions.
